rows.label: bf04030120_0010
rows.name:
A man climbed the World Tree toward Eden
so he could meet God.

rows.label: bf04030120_0020
rows.name:
But when he reached Eden,
he could not meet God.

rows.label: bf04030120_0030
rows.name:
So instead, as proof that he
had reached God's throne...

rows.label: bf04030120_0040
rows.name:
He brought back two Core
Crystals, Metsu and me.

rows.label: bf04030120_0050
rows.name: And once he made it back to Alst...

rows.label: bf04030120_0060
rows.name:
Why he did it, I can't say.
For greed...for power...

rows.label: bf04030150_0010
rows.name:
When Metsu awoke, he wielded the power granted him
as Heaven's Holy Grail—the power to erase the world.

rows.label: bf04030150_0020
rows.name:
with no doubt, purely, as if it was
the most natural thing in the world.

rows.label: bf04030150_0030
rows.name:
I awakened in answer to one Driver's call,
so I could defeat Metsu.

rows.label: bf04030150_0050
rows.name:
After a fierce battle, I managed to defeat Metsu,
but...

rows.label: bf04030150_0060
rows.name:
In that battle, three
Divine Beasts sank.

rows.label: bf04030160_0012
rows.name:
I sealed this power so that
it would never awaken again.

rows.label: bf04030160_0020
rows.name:
I took on this form, this
personality, and fell asleep.
